source_text: I don’t think we should wander until our tasks are complete.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.I don’t think we should wander until our tasks are complete.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.I don’t think we should wander until our tasks are complete."

translation: Nie powinniśmy się włóczyć, dopóki nie wykonamy wszystkich zadań.

source_text: I hope you solve your case, 1Hero. I believe in you.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.I hope you solve your case, 1Hero. I believe in you.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.I hope you solve your case, 1Hero. I believe in you."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że rozwiążesz tę sprawę, 1Hero. Wierzę w ciebie.

source_text: Thanks, Chloe. And if I can help you in any way, let me know.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Thanks, Chloe. And if I can help you in any way, let me know.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Thanks, Chloe. And if I can help you in any way, let me know."

translation: Dzięki, Chloe. Jeśli mogę ci jakoś pomóc, daj znać.

source_text: Please help us with the broken rigging cable. The chapel is a dangerous place with a swinging chandelier.

structure.raw_value: JuWoEx.Please help us with the broken rigging cable. The chapel is a dangerous place with a swinging chandelier.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoEx.Please help us with the broken rigging cable. The chapel is a dangerous place with a swinging chandelier."

translation: Pomóż nam naprawić zerwaną linę podtrzymującą żyrandol. Kołyszący się żyrandol sprawia, że kaplica jest niebezpieczna.

source_text: You are a kind man, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.You are a kind man, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.You are a kind man, 1Hero."

translation: Jesteś dobrym człowiekiem, 1Hero.

source_text: I’ve got my eye on you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BrFlDe.I’ve got my eye on you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlDe.I’ve got my eye on you, 1Hero."

translation: Będę cię obserwować, 1Hero.

source_text: What brings you here, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.What brings you here, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.What brings you here, 1Hero?"

translation: Co cię tu sprowadza, 1Hero?

source_text: Father Solomon is away, shopping. I am watching the church while he is away.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.Father Solomon is away, shopping. I am watching the church while he is away.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.Father Solomon is away, shopping. I am watching the church while he is away."

translation: Ojciec Solomon wyszedł na zakupy. Pilnuję kościoła, póki go nie ma.

source_text: Do you need to investigate anything here?

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Do you need to investigate anything here?
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Do you need to investigate anything here?"

translation: Musisz tu coś zbadać?

source_text: Nothing planned. But you never know where a clue might pop up.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Nothing planned. But you never know where a clue might pop up.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Nothing planned. But you never know where a clue might pop up."

translation: Nie mam planów. Nigdy nie wiadomo, gdzie trafi się wskazówka.

source_text: I’ll check the west end. But she may have gone outside.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I’ll check the west end. But she may have gone outside.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I’ll check the west end. But she may have gone outside."

translation: Sprawdzę zachodnią część. Mogła jednak wyjść na zewnątrz.

source_text: Does she ever go into town?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Does she ever go into town?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Does she ever go into town?"

translation: Czy ona czasem jeździ do miasta?

source_text: I’m the one who does the shopping. Judy prefers to stay at the church…

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I’m the one who does the shopping. Judy prefers to stay at the church…
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I’m the one who does the shopping. Judy prefers to stay at the church…"

translation: To ja robię zakupy. Judy woli zostawać w kościele…

source_text: This is unusual for her.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.This is unusual for her.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.This is unusual for her."

translation: To do niej niepodobne.

source_text: We’ll find her. Don’t worry.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We’ll find her. Don’t worry.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We’ll find her. Don’t worry."

translation: Znajdziemy ją. Nie martw się.

source_text: Sister Judy is safe. Perhaps I should go with you.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Sister Judy is safe. Perhaps I should go with you.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Sister Judy is safe. Perhaps I should go with you."

translation: Siostra Judy jest bezpieczna. Może powinienem pójść z tobą.

source_text: Stay here with Judy. If I see anything, I’ll come back for you.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Stay here with Judy. If I see anything, I’ll come back for you.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Stay here with Judy. If I see anything, I’ll come back for you."

translation: Zostań tutaj z Judy. Jeśli coś zauważę, wrócę po ciebie.

source_text: Please be careful, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.Please be careful, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.Please be careful, 1Hero."

translation: Uważaj na siebie, 1Hero.

source_text: I will, Chloe.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I will, Chloe.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I will, Chloe."

translation: Będę, Chloe.

source_text: I can use my container to collect some of this holy water.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I can use my container to collect some of this holy water.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I can use my container to collect some of this holy water."

translation: Mogę użyć swojego pojemnika, żeby nabrać trochę tej wody święconej.

source_text: If I had a container I could collect some of this holy water.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.If I had a container I could collect some of this holy water.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.If I had a container I could collect some of this holy water."

translation: Gdybym miał pojemnik, mógłbym nabrać trochę tej wody święconej.

source_text: What if I used an unholy container to collect holy water?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What if I used an unholy container to collect holy water?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What if I used an unholy container to collect holy water?"

translation: A gdybym użył nieświętego pojemnika do nabrania wody święconej?

source_text: Uhh, guys. We have a big problem.

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx.Uhh, guys. We have a big problem.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx.Uhh, guys. We have a big problem."

translation: Eee, słuchajcie. Mamy poważny problem.

source_text: It’s the leak…

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx.It’s the leak…
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx.It’s the leak…"

translation: Chodzi o przeciek…

source_text: The police officer is not very friendly.

structure.raw_value: ChBaEx.The police officer is not very friendly.
structure.script_literal: "ChBaEx.The police officer is not very friendly."

translation: Ten policjant nie jest zbyt miły.

source_text: He’s a pain in the ass for sure, but he’ll keep you safe.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.He’s a pain in the ass for sure, but he’ll keep you safe.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.He’s a pain in the ass for sure, but he’ll keep you safe."

translation: To upierdliwy typ, ale będzie was chronił.

source_text: 1Hero! You came.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.1Hero! You came.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.1Hero! You came."

translation: 1Hero! Przyszedłeś.

source_text: Of course, Sister Judy. We need to clean that room of yours.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Of course, Sister Judy. We need to clean that room of yours.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Of course, Sister Judy. We need to clean that room of yours."

translation: Oczywiście, siostro Judy. Musimy posprzątać twój pokój.

source_text: It’s pretty bad, 1Hero… It smells like mold.

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx.It’s pretty bad, 1Hero… It smells like mold.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx.It’s pretty bad, 1Hero… It smells like mold."

translation: Jest naprawdę źle, 1Hero… Czuć stęchliznę.

source_text: Oh, boy. That’s not good.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Oh, boy. That’s not good.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Oh, boy. That’s not good."

translation: Ojej. To niedobrze.

source_text: I hope the bed is not ruined. We can’t afford to be buying new beds with our low attendance.

structure.raw_value: JuSaCl.I hope the bed is not ruined. We can’t afford to be buying new beds with our low attendance.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaCl.I hope the bed is not ruined. We can’t afford to be buying new beds with our low attendance."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że łóżko nie jest zniszczone. Przy tak niskiej frekwencji nie stać nas na nowe.

source_text: I’m sure we can clean it.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.I’m sure we can clean it.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.I’m sure we can clean it."

translation: Na pewno uda nam się je wyczyścić.

source_text: Come on. Let’s get to work.

structure.raw_value: ChHaOp.Come on. Let’s get to work.
structure.script_literal: "ChHaOp.Come on. Let’s get to work."

translation: No chodź. Zabierajmy się do pracy.

source_text: I feel very refreshed today. I slept so well last night.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.I feel very refreshed today. I slept so well last night.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.I feel very refreshed today. I slept so well last night."

translation: Czuję się dziś wypoczęta. Wczoraj w nocy świetnie spałam.

source_text: This will be a long night.

structure.raw_value: BoBaDe.This will be a long night.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaDe.This will be a long night."

translation: To będzie długa noc.

source_text: We’ve got things under control. I feel safer knowing we’re being looked after.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.We’ve got things under control. I feel safer knowing we’re being looked after.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.We’ve got things under control. I feel safer knowing we’re being looked after."

translation: Panujemy nad sytuacją. Czuję się bezpieczniej, wiedząc, że ktoś nas pilnuje.

source_text: She’s getting ready. When does church start?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She’s getting ready. When does church start?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She’s getting ready. When does church start?"

translation: Przygotowuje się. Kiedy zaczyna się msza?

source_text: One hour… I just pray that people show up.

structure.raw_value: BrSaDe.One hour… I just pray that people show up.
structure.script_literal: "BrSaDe.One hour… I just pray that people show up."

translation: Za godzinę… Oby tylko ludzie przyszli.

source_text: Still hanging around the church?

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Still hanging around the church?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Still hanging around the church?"

translation: Wciąż kręcisz się przy kościele?

source_text: You’ll be able to go home tonight. I’ll make sure everything’s okay.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You’ll be able to go home tonight. I’ll make sure everything’s okay.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You’ll be able to go home tonight. I’ll make sure everything’s okay."

translation: Dziś wieczorem będziesz mogła wrócić do domu. Dopilnuję, żeby wszystko było w porządku.

source_text: Ugh! I’m mortified that Mom saw us.

structure.raw_value: ChSaOp.Ugh! I’m mortified that Mom saw us.
structure.script_literal: "ChSaOp.Ugh! I’m mortified that Mom saw us."

translation: Ugh! Umieram ze wstydu, że mama nas zobaczyła.

source_text: We were just having fun. It’s not a big deal.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.We were just having fun. It’s not a big deal.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.We were just having fun. It’s not a big deal."

translation: Po prostu dobrze się bawiliśmy. To nic takiego.

source_text: It’s just weird… That’s all.

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.It’s just weird… That’s all.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.It’s just weird… That’s all."

translation: To po prostu dziwne… Tyle.

source_text: 1Hero! The consequences would be dire!

structure.raw_value: MlShClNo1.1Hero! The consequences would be dire!
structure.script_literal: "MlShClNo1.1Hero! The consequences would be dire!"

translation: 1Hero! Konsekwencje byłyby tragiczne!

source_text: I’m not too happy about hanging around here.

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe.I’m not too happy about hanging around here.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnDe.I’m not too happy about hanging around here."

translation: Niezbyt mi się podoba to siedzenie tutaj.

source_text: Where is the detective?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Where is the detective?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Where is the detective?"

translation: Gdzie jest detektyw?

source_text: Melissa should be here soon.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Melissa should be here soon.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Melissa should be here soon."

translation: Melissa powinna niedługo przyjść.

source_text: I do hope everyone stays safe.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I do hope everyone stays safe.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I do hope everyone stays safe."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że wszystkim nic się nie stanie.

source_text: Be careful at the mansion, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ErWoEx.Be careful at the mansion, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ErWoEx.Be careful at the mansion, 1Hero."

translation: Uważaj w rezydencji, 1Hero.

source_text: Thank the Lord that Father Brian wasn’t here… Hannah was buck naked!

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Thank the Lord that Father Brian wasn’t here… Hannah was buck naked!
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Thank the Lord that Father Brian wasn’t here… Hannah was buck naked!"

translation: Dzięki Bogu, że ojca Briana tu nie było… Hannah była kompletnie naga!

source_text: Do I smell funny?

structure.raw_value: HnWoOp.Do I smell funny?
structure.script_literal: "HnWoOp.Do I smell funny?"

translation: Czy dziwnie pachnę?

source_text: My face smells like bleach.

structure.raw_value: HnWoEx.My face smells like bleach.
structure.script_literal: "HnWoEx.My face smells like bleach."

translation: Moja twarz pachnie wybielaczem.

source_text: I wonder where Mom went.

structure.raw_value: ChBaDe.I wonder where Mom went.
structure.script_literal: "ChBaDe.I wonder where Mom went."

translation: Ciekawe, dokąd poszła mama.

source_text: Something seemed funny about Carol and Mom.

structure.raw_value: ChBaDe.Something seemed funny about Carol and Mom.
structure.script_literal: "ChBaDe.Something seemed funny about Carol and Mom."

translation: Z Carol i mamą było coś dziwnego.

source_text: Tasha said you came all over a book. Must have been a really good book!

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.Tasha said you came all over a book. Must have been a really good book!
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.Tasha said you came all over a book. Must have been a really good book!"

translation: Tasha mówiła, że spuściłeś się na książkę. Musiała być naprawdę ciekawa!

source_text: You know you can count on me if you need muscle.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.You know you can count on me if you need muscle.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.You know you can count on me if you need muscle."

translation: Możesz na mnie liczyć, jeśli potrzebujesz krzepy.

source_text: I’ll keep you in mind, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I’ll keep you in mind, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I’ll keep you in mind, Hannah."

translation: Będę o tym pamiętał, Hannah.

source_text: Tasha sure does know a lot about history.

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp.Tasha sure does know a lot about history.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Tasha sure does know a lot about history."

translation: Tasha naprawdę dużo wie o historii.

source_text: Don’t get hurt, 1Hero. Come back safe.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.Don’t get hurt, 1Hero. Come back safe.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.Don’t get hurt, 1Hero. Come back safe."

translation: Nie daj się zranić, 1Hero. Wróć cały i zdrowy.

source_text: All’s clear, detective. No sign of any ghosts here.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.All’s clear, detective. No sign of any ghosts here.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.All’s clear, detective. No sign of any ghosts here."

translation: Czysto, pani detektyw. Nie ma tu żadnych duchów.

source_text: Something seems off about Erica.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.Something seems off about Erica.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.Something seems off about Erica."

translation: Z Ericą jest chyba coś nie tak.

source_text: I’ll explain everything later, Carol.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.I’ll explain everything later, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.I’ll explain everything later, Carol."

translation: Wszystko wyjaśnię później, Carol.

source_text: Despite your best efforts to defile this book, I’m still able to read it.

structure.raw_value: TaAnEx.Despite your best efforts to defile this book, I’m still able to read it.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnEx.Despite your best efforts to defile this book, I’m still able to read it."

translation: Mimo twoich starań, by sprofanować tę księgę, wciąż potrafię ją odczytać.
